case_title: Mariano Anto Bruno & Anr. v. The Inspector of Police
neutral_facts: The accused, a doctor, married a woman who was also a doctor. After their marriage, the accused and the victim had a child out of wedlock. The victim later miscarried a second pregnancy. The victim was subjected to harassment and mental cruelty by the accused, which led her to commit suicide. The accused was accused of causing the victim's death through harassment and cruelty. The victim's family filed a complaint against the accused and his mother-in-law after three weeks of her death. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 498A and 306 of the IPC. The High Court upheld the conviction. However, the Supreme Court found that the prosecution failed to establish the necessary elements of the offenses, including the intent and direct action required for conviction under Section 306 IPC. The accused was acquitted of the charges.
